subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should v2026.5.22-beta.1 still receive signed macOS beta desktop assets and a beta Sparkle appcast, or should this historical beta be documented/closed as intentionally having no macOS build?
rationale: The source checkout and live release state prove the assets/feed are still missing, but current release guidance says beta macOS apps are optional and the real publish path requires maintainer-held release-ops credentials.

options.title: Keep open for release-owner action
options.body: Use this issue as the tracker while deciding whether to land the signed-beta distribution path and run the restricted macOS publish flow.

options.title: Declare no macOS build for this beta
options.body: Close this only after a release owner records that this old beta train will intentionally remain without desktop assets or a beta feed.

options.title: Move future policy to the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue focused on the historical beta and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 for the broader beta appcast gate decision.

recommendation.title: Keep open for release-owner action
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the tracker while deciding whether to land the signed-beta distribution path and run the restricted macOS publish flow.
